title: Affine Cech transport of the external tensor-cycle formula
statement: Let k be a field, let f:X→Spec k and g:Y→Spec k have affine diagonals, and let F,G be quasi-coherent. Take finite affine covers U,V that cover X,Y. Given a natural transformation θ satisfying the explicit cochain-coordinate predicate of [lem-sc-picard-right-cech-cup-construction], there are natural-degree homology isomorphisms a from its tensor Cech source to picardExternalTotal and b from its product Cech target to the scalar model. The family a.inv ≫ H(θ.app G) ≫ b.hom satisfies IsPicardExternalCupHomology of [lem-sc-picard-external-cup-homology-unique]: on each scalar-model tensor-cycle representative it gives externalCup of the factor classes after the model comparisons. This neither constructs θ nor asserts cup invertibility, and has no short complex or normalized cochain map as input or output.

source.place: Tag 0BED, equation-kunneth-on-cech (33.29.1.1); Cohomology Tags 01FD, 07MB, 0FKV; official tag pages read

proof.text: In each natural degree obtain compatible Cech generator coordinates e and product comparison b from the geometric generator lemma.

Apply tensor_kunneth_nat to the two scalar models, using picardScalarModel_negative, to get s and its tensor-cycle formula. Define a as e.symm followed by s, converted to a ModuleCat isomorphism. Choose these comparisons degreewise.

For factor cycles x,y and a specified total cycle z, Kunneth produces z′ with the same cycle inclusion as z. Injectivity of the cycle inclusion gives z′=z. Its cycle formula and s.symm_apply_apply show that a.inv of the class of z is e of the summand tensor of the factor classes. Substitute in the transported map and apply the geometric generator formula. This is exactly IsPicardExternalCupHomology.

theorem picardRightCechCup_homology
    {k : Type w} [Field k] {X Y : Scheme.{w}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal f)] [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal g)]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    {ι κ : Type w} [Finite ι] [Finite κ]
    (U : ι → X.Opens) (V : κ → Y.Opens)
    (hU : ∀ i, IsAffineOpen (U i)) (hV : ∀ j, IsAffineOpen (V j))
    (hUc : iSup U = ⊤) (hVc : iSup V = ⊤)
    (θ : picardRightTensorCechFunctor f g U V F ⟶
      picardRightProductCechFunctor f g U V F)
    (hθ : IsPicardRightCechCup f g U V F θ)
    (G : Y.Modules) [G.IsQuasicoherent] :
    ∃ (a : ∀ n : ℕ,
        ((picardRightTensorCechFunctor f g U V F).obj G).homology (n : ℤ) ≅
          (picardExternalTotal f g F G).homology (n : ℤ))
      (b : ∀ n : ℕ,
        ((picardRightProductCechFunctor f g U V F).obj G).homology (n : ℤ) ≅
          (picardScalarModel (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
            (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).homology (n : ℤ)),
      IsPicardExternalCupHomology f g F G (fun n ↦
        (a n).inv ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (θ.app G) (n : ℤ) ≫ (b n).hom)
